question: Which epithets portray the goddess as the ornament of the three worlds and worshipped by great kings?
premises: The goddess is the ornament of the three worlds.
She is worshipped by the best among lords of men.
inference: The verse presents the goddess as the supreme feminine adornment of the cosmos, honored by eminent rulers.
plain_english: She is the ornament of the three worlds, the woman, worshipped by the best of kings.
